summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the unified History feature in StudyForge app. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working perfectly. The History page successfully aggregates data from Notes, Planner, and Practice features with full filtering, expansion, and delete capabilities.
passed_tests: Backend API: GET /api/history returns unified list from all 3 collections (10 items total)
Backend API: GET /api/history?item_type=note filters to notes only (5 items)
Backend API: GET /api/history?item_type=plan filters to plans only (2 items)
Backend API: GET /api/history?item_type=practice filters to practice only (2 items)
Backend API: DELETE /api/history/{type}/{id} deletes the correct item
Backend API: Error handling for invalid item types (400) and non-existent items (404)
Frontend: History page loads at /history with proper page header and filter tabs
Frontend: Filter tabs (All, Notes, Plans, Practice) work correctly with accurate counts
Frontend: History cards display type badges (Note/Plan/Practice), titles, subtitles, timestamps, and previews
Frontend: Expanding cards shows full result details - note content with key concepts/formulas/explanation, plan days with tasks, practice questions with options
Frontend: Delete button functionality removes items from the list
Frontend: Navigation includes History tab and properly links to /history route
Frontend: Navigation between all pages (Notes, Planner, Practice, History) works correctly
Frontend: History tab shows active state when on /history page
Frontend: Expand/collapse functionality works for all card types
Frontend: Type-specific detail views render correctly for each content type

success_percentage.backend: 100% (22/22 tests passed including 8 new history endpoint tests)
